data.long_meaning: Kakudmi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Kakud' which means 'knowledge'. This name is associated with Lord Ganesha, who is the god of wisdom and knowledge in Hindu mythology. Kakudmi is believed to bring wisdom, knowledge, and intelligence to the one who bears this name. The name Kakudmi carries the meaning “God of knowledge and wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Kakudmi usually hope their child will grow to embody god of knowledge and wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
